_comment: Copy to remotes.json (gitignored). Each remote = a Linux machine. Read-only (default): the console follows its stream-json run files (only ls and tail ever run there); paths: globs, letters/digits and _ . / ~ * ? - only. "control": true also lets the console START conversations there (needs `node console/rhost.mjs setup <name>` once; see README 'Remote servers'); port/node/claude optional.
